title: I can't believe it!
content: I have been dreaming about the mall and it's extensions of places every night for years. I thought I was the only one until stumbling upon this Reddit community. The mall is huge, it has a dark area entrance where it looks like a mall at night after closing. The middle is a huge open area of shops and people. There's a glass elevator in the middle and escalators, but I've never been on them. I usually go up these three carpeted steps with gold hand rails into a clothing store. There's a rotunda type hotel and spa on top and a parking garage, pool and Jacuzzi outside just beneath hotel and next to parking garage. There's a beach with a large concrete retaining wall separating it from the mall. By the beach is the large boat I go into a lot. Every time the ocean is rough with large tidal waves crashing into the boat windows. There's an outdoor concert area with high stacks of bleachers. There's also a grungy bar that has black walls and a separate room where bands play. There's a grocery store, reminds me of a Pic N Save from back in the day. There's an exit to the mall that is very bright. There's an airport with escalator walkways and I'm always absolutely terrified of getting on the plane. There's an outdoor small amusement park and water slides. I'm always accompanied by my mother or father who's passed away, or my aunt's and cousins who are still alive. I'll post more details later but I can't believe we are all visiting the same place! It has to be more than just a dream.
